meaning:
δι-αν-οίγω
[in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;]
to open up completely, to open: Luk.2:23 (LXX); pass., Mrk.7:34, Act.7:56. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, Luk.24:45, τ. καρδίαν, Act.16:14, pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, Luk.24:31; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, Luk.24:32, Act.17:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
(as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
